test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Rick was completing graduation last year.

options.text: Graduation is being completed by Rick last year.
Graduation was being completed by Rick last year.
Graduation were completed by Rick last year.
Graduation was completed by Rick last year.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Graduation was being completed by Rick last year. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in active voice, with **Rick **as the **subject **and "**completing graduation**" as the **action**.
 
• To convert it to passive voice, we need to make the object of the action (graduation) the subject of the sentence, and add a form of the verb "to be" and the past participle of the action verb (completed).
 
• The subject of the active sentence (Rick) becomes the object of the preposition "**by**" in the passive sentence.
 
• The correct passive sentence is "*Graduation was being completed by Rick last year*," with "**was being completed**" as the passive verb form.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
